description: This PHP source file defines the HomePageDao class responsible for data access operations related to home pages and module default pages within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve home page entries and default pages based on user role IDs and module names, ordered by priority.

classes.name: HomePageDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for retrieving home page and default module page data based on user roles and priorities.

methods.name: getHomePagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Retrieves home pages for specified user roles, ordered by priority and ID in descending order.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Retrieves default module pages for specified module and user roles, ordered by module name and priority.
